propositions: gate-snapshot janitor lacks a count-denominated reclamation axis and reclaims only by age and disk-pressure axes, which remain inert on large mostly-empty volumes
a host producing snapshots faster than the 7-day age threshold expires them accumulates entries without bound, causing filesystem metadata pressure rather than disk pressure
13,056 snapshot entries drove fseventsd to 26.3 GB RSS and >150% CPU utilization, exhausting swap and starving the host to load average 58 despite 886 GiB free disk space

max_entries tunable via REBAR_GATE_MAX_ENTRIES env, [snapshot] max_entries config, or DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES default must engage independently of disk headroom and compose with existing hysteresis and grace_seconds protections
the entry-count axis is resolved through the existing config seam and joined into wants_room to respect grace_seconds so concurrent gates never lose in-use entries
